description: Create a Kling task on RunAPI (image to video). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Declared type: string.

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for async notifications. Declared type: string.

duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds. Declared type: integer. Known values: 5, 10, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15.

enable_sound.description: Sound generation must remain disabled. Declared type: boolean.

first_frame_image_url.description: Public HTTP(S) JPG, JPEG, or PNG first-frame image URL. Declared type: string.

last_frame_image_url.description: Public HTTP(S) JPG, JPEG, or PNG final-frame image URL; cannot be combined with reference_image_urls or reference_video_url. Declared type: string.

mode.description: Generation mode. Declared type: string. Known values: "std", "pro".

model.description: RunAPI model slug for this model line.

output_resolution.description: Output resolution. Declared type: string. Known values: "720p", "1080p", "4k".

preserve_reference_video_audio.description: Preserve the reference video's original audio. Declared type: boolean.

prompt.description: Video description; reference media with matching numbered markers. Declared type: string.

reference_image_urls.description: Ordered public HTTP(S) JPG, JPEG, or PNG reference image URLs; cannot be combined with last_frame_image_url. Declared type: array.

reference_video_type.description: Use the video as a base edit or feature reference. Declared type: string. Known values: "base", "feature".

reference_video_url.description: Public HTTP(S) MP4 or MOV reference video URL; cannot be combined with last_frame_image_url. Declared type: string.

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: image_to_video
